# bioexcel/biobb_haddock/anarcii

## Summary

Wrapper class for the ANARCII antibody numbering tool.

ANARCII numbers antibody, TCR, and other immune receptor sequences. Given an input PDB structure it renumbers it (IMGT scheme by default) and writes the renumbered PDB structure.

Nextflow adapter of the [Anarcii](https://biobb-haddock.readthedocs.io/en/latest/utils.html#module-utils.anarcii) building block of [biobb_haddock](https://github.com/bioexcel/biobb_haddock) 5.3.1.

## Get started

```nextflow
include { BIOBB_HADDOCK_ANARCII } from 'bioexcel/biobb_haddock/anarcii'

workflow {
    BIOBB_HADDOCK_ANARCII(ch_input)
}
```

Optional input files are passed as `[]`.

## Inputs

| Name | Required | Formats | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `meta` | yes | | Map with at least an `id` key, used as tag and output file prefix |
| `input_pdb_path` | yes | pdb | Path to the input PDB structure file |

## Outputs

Each output channel emits `[meta, file]`. Files are named `<prefix>_<role>.<extension>`, where role is the output argument without `output_` and `_path`.
Optional outputs are only produced if requested in `ext.outputs`.

| Channel | Required | Formats (default first) | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `output_pdb_path` | yes | pdb | Path to the output renumbered PDB structure file |
| `versions_biobb_haddock` | yes | | `[process, 'biobb_haddock', version]`, also sent to the `versions` topic |

## Configuration

Set with `ext` in a `process` `withName` selector:

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `ext.properties` | Map of Anarcii properties (see below). Defaults: `[can_write_file_log: false]` |
| `ext.outputs` | Map of output argument to extension, for example `[output_pdb_path: 'pdb']`. Required outputs use their first format by default; optional outputs are only requested when listed here |
| `ext.prefix` | Output file prefix (default: `meta.id`) |

`raise_error` and `restart` are always set by the adapter: failed commands fail the task, and `-resume` replaces restart.
Do not set the `container_*` properties: Nextflow runs the task inside the biobb_haddock container.

```groovy
process {
    withName: 'BIOBB_HADDOCK_ANARCII' {
        ext.properties = [seq_type: 'antibody']
    }
}
```

### Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `seq_type` | string | "antibody" | Type of sequence to number. Values: antibody, tcr, vhh, sabdab. |
| `mode` | string | "accuracy" | Numbering mode. Values: accuracy, speed. |
| `verbose` | boolean | true | Print verbose output during numbering. |
| `remove_tmp` | boolean | true | Remove temporal files. |
| `sandbox_path` | string | "./" | Parent path to the sandbox directory. |
